description: Nucleoid verifies a live pressure model and frozen startup reading with colon-led checks
code:
pressure = 12
unit = "kPa"
monitor = {reading: pressure, unit: unit}
startup = pressure.value
assert: monitor.reading, 12
pressure = 18
unit = "Pa"
assert: monitor.reading, 18
assert: monitor.unit, "Pa"
assert: startup, 12
monitor.reading

description: Nucleoid verifies local invoice calculations before returning their structured result
code:
def invoice(quantity, rate):
    subtotal = quantity * rate
    assert: subtotal, 24
    return {subtotal: subtotal, ready: true}
result = invoice(3, 8)
assert: result.subtotal, 24
assert: result.ready, true
result.subtotal

description: Nucleoid verifies independent class alarms while retaining a snapshot of an earlier alert
code:
class Sensor
north = Sensor()
south = Sensor()
north.reading = 2
south.reading = 8
$Sensor.alert = $Sensor.reading > 5
saved = south.alert.value
assert: north.alert, false
assert: south.alert, true
south.reading = 1
assert: south.alert, false
assert: saved, true
saved

description: Nucleoid verifies transaction rollback against the whole caught reference error
code:
state = 1
message = ""
try:
    state = 2
    failed = missing
catch error:
    message = error
    assert: error, ReferenceError("missing is not defined")
assert: state, 1
assert: message, ReferenceError("missing is not defined")
state
